description: Implementation of the CustomerAttributeDao interface, providing database access methods for CustomerAttribute entities, including retrieval by ID, by option ID, by customer ID, and by option value ID, using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerAttribute, extending generic DAO and implementing custom retrieval methods.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute entity by its ID, joining related entities for eager fetching.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute based on store, customer ID, and attribute ID, with related entities fetched.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes for a specific customer within a store, with related entities.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes by option value ID within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionId (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes by option ID within a store.
